knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(dataRetrieval)
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
#install.packages("minpack.lm")
library(minpack.lm)
```

```{r}
site <- "06192500"
```

```{r}
rate_df <- readNWISmeas(siteNumbers = site)  %>% 
  select(site_no, date = measurement_dt, stage_ft = gage_height_va, q_cfs = discharge_va, qual = measured_rating_diff)
```

```{r}
rate_df_a <- rate_df %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>% 
  filter(year > 1975, year < 1997) %>% 
  filter(stage_ft != "NA", q_cfs != "NA", qual != "NA")
```

```{r}
rate_df_b <- rate_df %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>% 
  filter(year > 1996, year < 2010) %>% 
  filter(stage_ft != "NA", q_cfs != "NA", qual != "NA")
```

```{r}
rate_df_c <- rate_df %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>% 
  filter(year > 2009, year < 2022) %>% 
  filter(stage_ft != "NA", q_cfs != "NA", qual != "NA")
```


## Combine all three models in a loop and plot series:
```{r}
all_df <- list(rate_df_a, rate_df_b, rate_df_c)
all_names <- c("rate_df_a", "rate_df_b", "rate_df_c")

a <- 0
C <- 1
n <- 1

results_list <- list() #initialize an empty list to store loop iteration outputs

for (i in seq_along(all_df)) {  
  tmp_model <- nlsLM(q_cfs ~ C * (stage_ft - a)^n, 
                      start = list(C = C, n = n), 
                      data = all_df[[i]])  # i stands for '1,2, or 3' in this case so the first iteration of the loop will work on all_df[[1]], the second iteration on all_df[[2]]... etc. 

  # Extract the desired coefficients from 'tmp_model' and store them as a row in the 'results_list'
  results_list[[i]] <- tibble(names = all_names[i],  # Model name
    C = coef(tmp_model)["C"],              # Extracted C value
    n = coef(tmp_model)["n"]               # Extracted n value
  )
}

# Combine all rows into a single tibble
results <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Print final tibble
print(results)

```

Now we will generate another loop that will iterate through each our model dataframes (all_df) and the new result tibble.
```{r}
# Loop over each row in 'results' to generate plots for each of the models:

for (i in seq_along(all_df)) {
  # Get the corresponding model (data) and coefficients (C and n)
  model_data <- all_df[[i]]
  C_value <- results$C[i]
  n_value <- results$n[i]
  model_name <- results$names[i]
  
  # Create the title for each plot dynamically using the appropriate model name
  site_title <- paste("Gage", site, "Model", substr(model_name, nchar(model_name), nchar(model_name))) #this takes the last character from the model name and pastes it into our plot title
  
  # Create the dynamic annotation text with the formula (C and n)
  eqn_label <- paste("Q ==", round(C_value, 0), " * x * Stage^", round(n_value, 2)) 

  # Define the formula for the smoothing line (custom formula with C and n)
  formula <- y ~ C * (x - a)^n
  
  # Create the plot
  p_tmp <- ggplot(model_data, aes(x = stage_ft, y = q_cfs)) +
    geom_point() +
    theme_linedraw(base_size = 16) +
    labs(x = "Gage height (ft)", 
         y = "Discharge (cfs)", 
         title = site_title, 
         subtitle = paste(min(model_data$year), "to", max(model_data$year))) +
    lims(x = c(0, 10), y = c(0, 40000)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "nls", 
                formula = formula, 
                se = FALSE, 
                method.args = list(start = list(C = C_value, n = n_value))) +
    annotate(
      geom = "text", 
      size = 8, 
      x = 5, 
      y = 31000, 
      label = eqn_label, 
      parse = TRUE
    )
assign(paste("plot_", i, sep=""), p_tmp)
}

plot_1
plot_2
plot_3
```
